description: Attacks all enemies and grants a different harmful effect on each use. On the first use, leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns. On the second use, decreases the Attack Bar by 30%. From the third use onward, stuns the target for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

name: Emissary of the Black Gate (Passive)
description: Increases the boss's Attack Bar by 35% each time an enemy's turn ends. [Automatic Effect]

name: Ominous Blessing (Passive)
description: Recovers 10% of the boss's HP and reduces the duration of harmful effects on the boss by 1 turn at the start of its turn. [Automatic Effect]

name: Brutal Slaughter
description: Attacks all enemies 4 times to inflict Continuous Damage for 2 turns on each hit and destroy the enemy's MAX HP by 30% of the damage dealt.

name: Executioner's Blade
description: Attacks the enemy with the most destroyed HP and deals damage that ignores Defense in proportion to the target’s destroyed HP.

name: The Insignificant (Passive)
description: Decreases the Critical Damage received by 50%. If the damage taken from an enemy is 10% or less than the boss's MAX HP, the chance of being granted with any effects from the enemy is decreased by 70%. [Automatic Effect]

name: Commander of Terror (Passive)
description: At the start of its turn, all other allies team up to attack the enemy with the most destroyed HP. [Automatic Effect]

name: Terror of the Nazgûl
description: Attacks all enemies 4 times. The first 3 hits leave a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 70% chance, and the final hit stuns the targets for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

name: Corrosion of Morgul
description: Attacks the enemy and grants the Curse of Death on the enemy target, that cannot be removed, to inflict damage by 25% of the target's MAX HP and disturb HP recovery for 4 turns. The enemy defeated by this effect cannot be revived during battle, and this effect cannot be applied to more than one enemy at the same time.

name: Veil of Dread (Passive)
description: Decreases the chance of being hit with a Critical Hit by 50%, and creates [Veil of Dread] at the start of its turn. While [Veil of Dread] is active, the boss is immune to all effects from the enemy and the HP cannot drop below 1. In addition, enemies cannot be granted beneficial effects. [Veil of Dread] is removed when the boss is attacked, and the number of hits required to remove it increases based on the number of allies alive. [Automatic Effect]

name: Whirlwind Slice
description: Attacks the enemy 2 times. Each hit decreases its Defense for 2 turns and leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns.

name: Medrozobalt
description: Attacks all enemies 3 times to deal damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken, and removes all beneficial effects.

name: Fatal Cleave (Passive)
description: Deals damage that ignores 10% of the target's Defense when attacking the enemy. The percentage of Defense ignored increases by 10% whenever the boss gains a turn. [Automatic Effect]

name: Raging Whirlwind (Passive)
description: Increases its Attack Bar by 30% whenever the enemy's turn ends. [Automatic Effect]

name: Nebeladora
description: Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects and grant Oblivion for 1 turn.

name: Aggressive Assault
description: Attacks the enemy with the highest Attack Bar 3 times, dealing damage that ignores Defense based on the difference in Attack Speed between the boss and the target, and decreasing its Attack Bar by 30% on each hit.

name: Magic Fog (Passive)
description: Whenever its turn ends, decreases the Attack Speed of all enemies for 2 turns with a 50% chance. [Automatic Effect]

name: Sensory Disruption (Passive)
description: Attacks taken from enemies with lower Attack Speed than the boss always land as a Glancing Hit. [Automatic Effect]

name: Quadruple Slash
description: Attacks all enemies 4 times. The first hit removes 1 beneficial effect with a 75% chance, the second hit decreases their Defense for 2 turns with a 75% chance, the third hit grants Seal for 2 turns with a 75% chance, and the fourth hit disturbs HP recovery for 2 turns with a 75% chance.

name: Swordplay Onslaught
description: Attacks the enemy 7 times. First to sixth hits remove 1 beneficial effect with a 20% chance and stun for 1 turn with a 20% chance. The last hit deals damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.

name: Final Counter
description: Attacks the enemy to instantly defeat the target. This skill can be used when the boss has no weapons.

name: Expert Swordsman (Passive)
description: Whenever the boss loses 20% HP, one of its weapons breaks. When its weapon breaks, the boss gains a turn, and its Attack Power and Attack Speed increase by 20%. [Automatic Effect]

name: Tactical Assessment (Passive)
description: At the start of its turn, the ally with the best HP condition goes under the Threat state while enemies attack with a single-target skill 1 time. [Automatic Effect]
